conventions.format: This file is both a kawalys.graph.v1 envelope (validates against ../fixture/envelope.schema.v1.json, 0 contract_errors) and the ground truth that ../fixture/score.py loads with --ground-truth. Extra keys (id, v1_form, specifier, evidence_token, local_name, case, note, fixture, conventions, negatives, external_imports, coverage_cases) are ignored by the schema.
conventions.id_root: ids are relative to holdout-v1/ (src/packages/ledger/src/money.ts); symbols are path::Symbol or path::Class.method; an anonymous default export is path::default
conventions.ts_path_aliases: src/tsconfig.json, baseUrl '.' (= src/): @ledger -> packages/ledger/src/index.ts, @ledger/* -> packages/ledger/src/*, ~atlas/* -> packages/atlas/src/*
conventions.imports: R1: one imports edge per import statement, to the literal specifier's file after alias resolution; form import|reexport|require|dynamic (R3); names[] optional detail. v1_form repeats form because score.py reads v1_form.
conventions.calls: only cross-file calls are enumerated; a call starts at the innermost enclosing listed symbol (function, method, component); a decorator call starts at the scope that evaluates it (the module for top-level decorators); class instantiation is a call to the class
conventions.basis: R4: observed when the binding is static (import/require binding, destructuring, star import with a literal __all__, super in single inheritance); inferred when receiver typing or inherited-method lookup is needed; unknown for dynamic loading and HTTP (R5)
conventions.unknown: to = null plus target_hint; no ground-truth observed or inferred edge shares a file:line with an unknown, so the R5 file+line match is unambiguous
conventions.contains: module -> top-level function/class/component; class -> method; line = definition line; line_source derived (R7)
conventions.negatives: an engine edge with basis observed or inferred matching (type, from, to) is a hard fail (R8); from '*' matches any source
